            'privilege', expanded_acl.privilege,
            'grantable', expanded_acl.grantable

                     expanded_acl.privilege collate "C", expanded_acl.grantable
        )
        from (
          select distinct
            case when a.grantee = 0 then 'PUBLIC'

            and con.conffeqop is null

        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
